I've added the Bunker section (SEC-001) with working 2D and 3D views, but you need to confirm several component mappings before they can be treated as verified. The project type-checks with no errors. I haven't run it in a browser, so rendering, clicking, selection sync, pan/zoom and orbit are all untested.

Two things limit what the views can show:
- **There is no `data.json` for this section.** The rules don't allow me to create one, so no specifications, operating states, alarms or flow animation appear. Every item's data record is `null`, and the overview says so.
- **I only used `manual-data.json` to cross-check tags.** Its entry IDs are stored for reference; the code never loads the file.

## What was built

**Library object cards** (`src/objects/OBJ-003` to `OBJ-009/card.json`): kind, description, aspect and in/out ports, measured from each 2D image. Each card's `image` field matches the stored 2D file name; the viewer ignores a card without it.

**Shared code in `src/shared/schematic/`** (new; there was nothing to reuse):
- `types.ts` and `geometry.ts`: plain data types, port positions, pipe routes and "what is connected to this" (pipes are followed through joints, never through crossings).
- `2d.tsx`: SVG symbols and pipes, with pan, zoom, click/keyboard selection and highlighting of connected pipes and equipment. It doesn't load three.js.
- `3d.tsx`: React Three Fiber scene with orbit controls, built from the same geometry. Pipe thickness follows the 65A/100A/150A labels but is visual only.
- `panel.tsx` and `selection.ts`: one overview panel and one selection callout, used by both views so they match.

**Section files in `src/sections/bunker/`**:
- `schematic.ts`: the only geometry source, traced in the drawing's pixel coordinates. It has 75 components, 118 pipe runs and the drawing's text labels.
- `Diagram2D.tsx` and `Diagram3D.tsx`: thin wrappers using the viewer's `SectionViewProps`. Items are selected by drawing tag, or by instance ID when untagged.

No existing files were modified.

Each Library 2D image is a framed panel with a photo beside the symbol, so the 2D view clips each image to its symbol area. The image keeps its aspect ratio. The 3D view shows each object's 3D image through `ObjectModel3D`.

## Component mapping (75 components, 43 tagged)

I only placed a Library object where the evidence agreed. That means the manual entry's type names exactly one object, or the drawn symbol rules out the alternatives.

| Tags | Type | Library object | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| FB001, FB002 | Relief valve (spring) | OBJ-004 | Partially verified: the manual entries are tagged **FA001/FA002** |
| FB582/572/571/581, FA584/574/573/583, FA582/572/571/581 (12) | Ball valve | OBJ-005 | Partially verified |
| 7 untagged flanged spools | Spool | OBJ-009 | Partially verified (symbol only) |
| FB541/542, FA543/544, FA541/542 (6) | Gate valve with blind flange | none in the Library | Partially verified, shared symbol |
| FB112, FB111, FA515–FA521, FB511/512, FA511–514 (15) | Butterfly valve | **OBJ-006 or OBJ-007?** | Ambiguous, shared symbol |
| FB543/544, FA545–548 (6) | Stop (globe) valve | **OBJ-008?** | Ambiguous, shared symbol |
| FA575 | Angle valve with spring | **OBJ-003?** The manual calls it "self-closing" | Ambiguous |
| Upper-left D.O. tank | Tank | — | Ambiguous: two manual tank entries claim it |
| Lower-left D.O. tank | Tank | — | Partially verified (D.O S TOR.TK(S), via related valves only) |
| FB513, 4 F.O. tanks, 6 PI gauges, 6 end flanges, 6 vents, 1 circled pipe end | various | — | Missing data |

Totals: 0 verified, 28 partially verified, 23 ambiguous, 24 missing data.

## Pipes

- **Joined:** 116 of the 118 runs are traced end to end, including the junction dots at the three manifolds.
- **Not joined:** I treated these as crossings:
  - FB105 and FB104 hop over the FB100 line.
  - FB100 is broken where it meets FA101.
  - FA101 crosses the D.O. manifold.
- **Unresolved:** the outlets of FB001 and FB0
